import_reason: India has limited crude reserves relative to refinery throughput and transport demand.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Large refining base; limited upstream resource endowment
notes: Electrification and efficiency reduce demand slowly; domestic refining does not replace crude feedstock.

import_reason: Household savings and jewellery demand exceed domestic mine supply.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Deep jewellery ecosystem; negligible mine supply
notes: Financial-gold products and recycling can reduce physical inflows; cultural demand limits the ceiling.

import_reason: Advanced semiconductor fabrication and packaging capacity remain below domestic electronics demand.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Growing design and assembly base; early fabrication and packaging capacity
notes: Assembly growth can raise both exports and component imports, so impact must be measured net.

import_reason: Power, steel and cement users require grades and volumes not fully met by domestic mines.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Large domestic coal output; quality and logistics gaps persist
notes: Renewables, efficiency, rail logistics and selective mine output matter more than blanket import compression.

import_reason: Gas demand exceeds domestic production and LPG consumption relies on imported supply.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Gas grid and terminals are expanding; upstream supply is constrained
notes: Diversification reduces concentration risk; biogas and electrification provide limited substitution.

import_reason: Airline fleet expansion and defence or space requirements depend on globally concentrated OEMs.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Strong space and defence engineering; limited commercial aircraft integration
notes: Productive imports can build connectivity and future capability; local content is the practical target.

import_reason: Demand for computers and servers outpaces domestic component ecosystems and branded product scale.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Fast-growing electronics assembly and EMS base
notes: Final assembly is feasible sooner than deep component localisation.

import_reason: Industrial, solar and investment demand exceed limited domestic silver mine output.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Established precious-metal refining and recycling network
notes: Recovery from electronics and industrial scrap can help, but collection quality is the bottleneck.

import_reason: Consumption exceeds domestic oil-palm output and suitable growing zones are limited.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Oil-palm programmes in southern and north-eastern states
notes: Expansion competes for land and water; food-price and ecological safeguards constrain substitution.

import_reason: Farm nutrient demand and feedstock constraints exceed domestic complex-fertiliser supply.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Large blending and distribution base; imported potash and phosphates
notes: More local conversion still relies on imported mineral feedstocks, limiting net savings.

import_reason: Soybean-oil demand exceeds domestic crush and oilseed yields.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Large soybean acreage and crushing industry
notes: Yield, seed quality and processing improvements are more realistic than acreage-only expansion.

import_reason: Copper smelting and manufacturing demand exceed domestic ore production and grade availability.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Domestic smelting and fabrication capacity; limited mine pipeline
notes: Recycling can supplement supply, but ore imports remain linked to productive downstream activity.

import_reason: Electronics, catalysts and refining require specialised precious-metal compounds not made at sufficient scale.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Specialised refiners exist but collection and refining scale are limited
notes: Urban mining and catalyst recovery offer a clearer route than primary extraction.

import_reason: Nitrogen fertiliser demand and gas economics exceed efficient domestic production.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Large installed fertiliser capacity and distribution network
notes: Domestic output can replace product imports but may still require imported gas, so net impact is lower.

import_reason: Display modules and flat-panel components depend on East Asian scale and technology ecosystems.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Strong device assembly; nascent display-component base
notes: Module assembly is nearer-term; substrate and panel fabrication require scale and technology transfer.

import_reason: Power devices, LEDs and discrete semiconductors require specialised fabs and materials ecosystems.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Design talent and announced packaging or fab projects
notes: Power and mature-node devices are more tractable than leading-edge chips.

import_reason: Battery-cell demand is rising faster than domestic cell production and critical-mineral processing.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Pack assembly and announced cell plants; weak mineral base
notes: Cells are buildable, but lithium, nickel and cobalt inputs will remain substantially imported.

import_reason: Electric-arc steelmaking and foundries need more quality scrap than formal domestic collection supplies.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Large steel recycling demand; fragmented vehicle and construction scrap collection
notes: Formal collection, sorting and end-of-life vehicle channels can create a relatively fast net lever.

import_reason: Secondary aluminium capacity needs clean scrap that domestic recovery systems do not supply at scale.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Large aluminium fabricating base and established recyclers
notes: Better segregation and quality standards can displace imports without primary-mining expansion.

import_reason: India's cutting and polishing export industry relies on imported rough diamonds.
domestic_capacity_proxy: World-scale cutting and polishing cluster
notes: Imports are productive inputs with a large export offset; value-add and export recovery matter more than cutting imports.

import_reason: Computer and office-machine assembly relies on imported specialised parts and subassemblies.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Growing EMS and final-product assembly base
notes: Supplier qualification and scale are the main constraints.

import_reason: Sunflower and safflower oil demand exceeds domestic oilseed production and crush economics.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Existing oilseed farms and crushing capacity
notes: Yield expansion and crop switching have land and farmer-income trade-offs.

import_reason: Copper fabricators and smelters require more consistent scrap than domestic collection provides.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Large informal recovery sector and formal smelting capacity
notes: Traceability, sorting and formalisation can turn domestic waste into usable industrial feedstock.

import_reason: Polyethylene demand exceeds domestic grade mix and cracker capacity.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Large petrochemical producers and converters
notes: New capacity can replace resin imports but often requires imported hydrocarbon feedstock.

import_reason: Firms import specialised machinery where domestic volumes do not justify local designs or tooling.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Broad machinery and engineering supplier base
notes: Focus on repeatable machine families; one-off equipment imports are often productive and efficient.

import_reason: Cement, metals and industrial users import petroleum coke grades and volumes tied to global refining.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Large cement sector with alternative-fuel capability
notes: Waste-derived fuels and process efficiency can substitute demand, subject to emissions constraints.

import_reason: Fertiliser and chemical production depend on phosphate rock and acid chains with limited domestic resources.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Large fertiliser conversion capacity; weak phosphate resource base
notes: Overseas supply security and nutrient efficiency are more realistic than full localisation.

import_reason: Pulse demand periodically exceeds domestic harvests because of yield, acreage and weather volatility.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Large pulse-growing base across central and western India
notes: Seeds, irrigation, storage and price signals can raise supply; climate variability remains material.

import_reason: Copper refining and fabrication demand exceed available domestic concentrate and anode supply.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Domestic refining and fabrication capacity
notes: Smelting can be localised, but imported concentrate limits the net-deficit gain.

import_reason: PVC demand from construction and infrastructure exceeds domestic resin and feedstock capacity.
domestic_capacity_proxy: Large converters and planned resin capacity
notes: Domestic resin production can replace finished resin imports but retains feedstock dependence.
